## What

- Resolves 3 of the 26 `Unspecified: insufficient source detail` cells in `use-case-inventory.md` with citations to vendor documentation that actually describes execution structure (not just capability):
  - **Lead research & enrichment** -> `Sequential pipeline` (Clay's documented waterfall enrichment)
  - **On-call incident summary** -> `Parallel fan-out` (PagerDuty SRE Agent engineering blog), plus `Inherently multi-agent` and `AI-coordinated, planning` from the same source
  - **Contract review & red-lining** -> Coordination filled in as `AI-coordinated, planning` (LexisNexis Protege)
- Reverts three resolutions from an earlier commit in this PR where the cited source does not carry the claim (see "Review pass" below).
- Repairs every broken citation link in the file (see "Review pass" below).
- Fixes the "Autonomous maintenance run (night shift)" row's citations: the Google whitepaper title was wrong (no such paper as "The New SDLC in the AI Era" -- the real paper is "The New SDLC With Vibe Coding" by Osmani, Saboo & Kartakis, Google, May 2026, on Kaggle), and adds working links for Claude Code dynamic workflows and Linear coding sessions.
- Swaps the Clay citation for open-access sources: the Clay University lesson requires a signup to view. Replaced with `clay.com/guides/waterfall-enrichment` and `hunter.io/blog/waterfall-enrichment`, both open and both explicitly describing the sequential provider order the classification relies on.

## Why

Per `schema-agentic-use-cases.md`'s "Classifying a row" guidance, and the Aug 20 WG action item to add source/reference links to the use case inventory.

## Review pass

A wholesale review of this PR turned up three problems, all fixed in `3dbfdbb`.

**Three resolutions did not survive scrutiny and were reverted to `Unspecified`:**

- **Incident post-mortem drafting** -- the PagerDuty writeup covers live investigation only. It mentions neither timeline reconstruction nor post-incident writeups; its single use of "post-mortem" refers to analysing a failed sub-agent. The "shared engine" carry-over is not in the source.
- **Network anomaly detection** -- Darktrace evidences hypothesis-test iteration, but `Convergence loop` requires iterating against a *deterministic gate*, and no cited source describes one.
- **Compliance deadline tracking** -- Avalara names five stages but states no execution order between them, and describes tax return filing rather than this row's calendar-scan-and-alert workflow.

**One row contradicted its own citation.** On-call incident summary carried `Single-agent sufficient` and `Fixed/scripted` against a source whose stated reason for splitting agents is that "if a single agent struggles with a large context, the answer is to split the context into multiple agents," and whose supervisor "formulates a few candidate root causes" then re-plans as results arrive. That source now sets all three cells.

**Every citation URL was fetched. Three were dead:**

| Citation | Status | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| `avalara.com/.../avalara-intelligent-agents-deterministic-systems` | 403 | Bare path redirects to a trailing slash the WAF blocks; needs the `.html` suffix |
| `globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/12/10/3203092` | 404 | Release ID does not resolve; replaced with LawSites' Dec 2025 writeup |
| `github.com/cnoe-io/ai-platform-engineering` | 301 | Org renamed `cnoe-io` -> `caipe-io` (5 references) |

Two claims carried no link at all (the Darktrace whitepaper, the Incident.io talk) and now point at fetchable sources. The QAD row was dated "Feb 2026" against a `/2025/09/` URL. Separately, 7 internal links pointed at `./classification-schema.md`, which does not exist -- the file is `schema-agentic-use-cases.md`. That one is pre-existing on `main`, not introduced here.

All 22 citation URLs in the file now return 200.

## Remaining

23 `Unspecified` cells. 15 of them share one Notes line -- "concurrency vs. sequence of these reads not stated in cited sources" -- which the review traced to a contradiction in the schema rather than to missing sources. Addressed separately in #47 so the definitional change can be judged on its own merits; that PR takes this file to 4.

## Note

An earlier commit touched `schema-agentic-use-cases.md` and was reverted in full -- net zero change to that file. This PR is `use-case-inventory.md` only.
